title: Rendlesham Forest incident near Europe's largest nuclear stockpile

tellings.quote: look no further than the Rendlessham Forest incident [music] in 1980.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to the Rendlesham Forest incident, a reported 1980 encounter with strange lights or a craft in a forest in England. He frames it as happening near what was said to be Europe's largest store of nuclear weapons, offered as an example of unexplained objects showing interest in nuclear sites.
